Subject: Reseller margin evidence & SKU bundling questions for AegisHealth private offer

Maya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. As we move toward the private offer for AegisHealth (AEGIS-PO-1427), we need one quick clarification from procurement to finalize the invoice and channel flow: are you expecting the reseller commission to be embedded as a list-price reduction (Net of reseller) or paid as a separate commission line to the reseller after invoicing?

Attached is our current SKU mapping for the proposed bundle (Aegis_SKU_map_v1.csv) and a draft PO (Aegis_PO_Draft_v3.pdf). For our internal approvals we also need: 1) the reseller’s commission schedule or MSA reference and 2) confirmation of who will be responsible for paying the reseller (Aegis directly or Redwood on your behalf). If the commission is paid by you, we need the invoicing cadence so finance can set up pass-through records.

What we need from you to keep the timeline (targeting execution by 6/30):
- Confirm preferred commission model (embedded vs separate)
- Attach reseller commission schedule or MSA excerpt (if available)
- Any tax/treatment notes we should be aware of for your region

If easier, we can hop on a 20-min call with your procurement and your reseller (if they’re comfortable) to walk through the options.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Neha —

Thanks for the note and the docs. Quick answers from our side:
- We typically prefer commissions to be handled outside of list price (separate commission payments to the reseller) to keep our internal reporting clean.
- I can share the reseller MSA excerpt but need to get approval from our Finance lead (looping procurement). We should be able to provide the MSA excerpt and a one-page commission schedule by Thursday.
- Tax treatment: reseller will be acting as an authorized reseller in the US and we expect normal reseller VAT/ Sales Tax handling (no special withholding). I’ll confirm the exact tax flow with Procurement.

One clarification on your end: if the commission is paid outside list price, will Redwood send a separate invoice to Aegis for the commission or will Redwood pay the reseller directly and then invoice Aegis for the net PO amount? That will determine our internal PO lines.

Maya Singh

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Reseller margin evidence & SKU bundling questions for AegisHealth private offer

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick reply. Re: how Redwood handles commission payments, here are two standard approaches we support and the downstream implications: 

1) Commission paid separately by Aegis to the reseller (Aegis invoices/resolves to reseller)
   - Redwood invoices Aegis for the full list price; Aegis retains responsibility to pay the reseller per your agreement.
   - Pros: simpler for Redwood invoicing; keeps our revenue recognition straightforward.
   - Cons: Aegis needs to track separate commission payments and may want commission lines on PO for internal approval.

2) Redwood pays reseller and nets the commission from Aegis invoice (commission as a post-invoice rebate)
   - Redwood would issue payment to reseller under a reseller onboarding agreement; Redwood invoices Aegis for net amount or invoices full amount and issues a separate credit for the commission — we can model either.
   - Pros: Aegis has one payment flow, reseller gets guaranteed payment.
   - Cons: Requires reseller onboarding paperwork (W-9/ACH/corporate docs) and a short finance setup; Redwood needs reseller payout approval.

Operational asks if option 2 is preferred: reseller’s signed MSA or commission schedule, W-9 (or local equivalent), bank remittance details, and a designated contact for payout disputes. I’ve attached an internal workbook that shows how each approach impacts invoice lines and revenue timing (reseller_commission_workbook.xlsx).

On packaging: we reviewed the SKU map Neha sent and propose a single bundled SKU (reserved-capacity + managed-support addon) to keep pricing clean for procurement. If Aegis needs per-feature line items we can provide a supplemental breakout for internal review, but the private offer will reference the bundled SKU. For audit evidence, we can include the SKU breakout as an attachment to the PO.

If you’re comfortable with option 2 we’ll start the reseller onboarding checklist and provide the payout timeline. If option 1, please flag the PO lines you want to include for commission so we can mirror them in our invoicing.

Ben Carter
Director, Deals — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: reseller_commission_workbook.xlsx
